evidence.claim: The incident reproduced with 4 failures and 12 passing focused tests.
Url.netloc used `if self.port`, omitting an explicitly supplied port 0.
PoolManager.connection_from_host and ProxyManager initialization used truthiness checks that defaulted explicit port 0 to the scheme port.
The focused verification command passed all 16 tests.
Neighboring connectionpool, poolmanager, proxymanager, and util suites passed: 462 passed, 7 skipped.
The final diff changes only the three port checks in the two allowed production files; no tests or unrelated files changed.
